newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Rate falls at Tunisian treasury auction.
newsitem.headline: Rate falls at Tunisian treasury auction.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury raised 40 million dinars at its weekly auction of treasury bills dated March 18, and repaid maturing paper totalling 27.9 million dinars.
The issue raised 10 million dinars of 52-week paper at a 6.8750 percent coupon rate, down from 6.9375 percent last week. It also sold 52-week paper worth 30 million dinars at 6.9375.
Banks bid for 328 million dinars for 13-, 26-, 52-week paper at between 6.7500 and 7.1250 percent. The Treasury issued only 52-week paper. ($1 =1.08 dinar)
